text:
maria-partners: EdgeCorp's PO (via Azure Marketplace) got rejected by the portal this morning — error: 'po_xml_invalid: missing <BillingEntityId>' and signature-type mismatch. Need someone to ping Azure integration contact, customer wants onboarding before EOD.

aj-sales: Ugh. Do we have the portal error details? Can we transform the PO to the new schema on our side? cc @leo-integrations

maria-partners: Error log below:
```
HTTP 400
error_code: po_xml_invalid
message: Missing element BillingEntityId
signature: unsupported-signer-type
```
Partner reports their procurement system emits legacy PO v1 without BillingEntityId. They can't change it without an internal ticket.

leo-integrations: We can try a transient XML shim to inject BillingEntityId using vendor alias mapping during ingest. Risk: changes the original PO payload and could complicate audit/reconciliation unless finance signs off. Would preserve original PO hash in a metadata field.

clare-finance: We are not comfortable silently mutating POs. If we inject fields, we need an amendment/email from the buyer acknowledging the change and EIN mapping. Also need AP to have the original PO attached.

sam-legal: Also flag: partner's PO contains a contract-level redline — payment_terms set to "net 90". That's outside our standard terms. We need either an approved exception or an SOW amendment signed.

aj-sales: Customer is trying to go live this week. Can we do an exception path where partner signs an amendment (email ok) and finance does manual processing? @sam-legal @clare-finance

leo-integrations: Short-term workaround: we can accept the PO via manual entry into our billing portal (internal tool) and attach the original XML as evidence. That will bypass Marketplace's automated validation but requires manual reconciliation and a ticket to Marketplace ops so records align.

maria-partners: Is manual entry allowed for marketplace-sourced deals? We'll need approval from Marketplace Ops and an expedited review from Azure so the onboarding record isn't inconsistent.

marketplace-bot: Ticket created: AZURE-ONBOARD-4782 — Portal validation failure (missing BillingEntityId + signature mismatch). Assigned to suzanne@azuremarketplace for expedited review. ETA 24-48h.

sam-legal: I'll prepare a short amendment template (acknowledging injected BillingEntityId and accepting payment terms exception if approved) and share in ~30m. Once signed, finance can process manual entry. :thumbsup:

clare-finance: We can process manual entry once amendment is signed and EIN is verified. Please include AP reference "MKT-4782" on the ledger entry and attach original XML.

aj-sales: I'll coordinate with EdgeCorp PM and push for the signed amendment. Thanks team. @maria-partners can you escalate to Suzanne now? :pray:

maria-partners: On it — just emailed suzanne@azuremarketplace with the error log and attached PO XML. Will update here when they reply. Closing this thread for now but will follow up when we have their response.
